_comment: Feasibility gate for the clean-image extractor. Written BEFORE the first extraction run on any record. Criteria are evaluated on the 'tune' split (PTB-XL folds 1-8), clean synthetic renderings, lead II, 500 Hz source.

metric_definitions.nrmse: RMSE(extracted - reference) / (P99 - P1 of reference), after documented alignment (DC offset + bounded time lag).
metric_definitions.pearson: Pearson correlation between aligned extracted and reference waveforms on valid samples.
metric_definitions.valid_coverage: Fraction of image columns inside the trace x-extent that carry a valid (unmasked) extracted sample.
metric_definitions.heart_rate_error: |mean HR from extracted R peaks - mean HR from reference R peaks| in beats/min (same detector on both signals).
metric_definitions.r_amplitude_error: |R-wave amplitude (peak minus local pre-QRS baseline) extracted - reference| in mV, matched beats.

if_gate_fails: Investigate root cause on clean images and fix the extractor; if no credible extractor within the time budget, report infeasibility honestly instead of building UI around it.
